preprocessing: FR1: same source-fitted PCA8 directions/scales; apply source centering in projected coordinates before clipping, subtract the identically transformed gray reference, divide by6 to preserve [-1,1]. All six arms and readout scales refitted under this identical label-free repair. No approximation deduplication.
selection: All arms: early stop by inner held-source NLL then Brier then higher AUC then earlier epoch; outer hyperparameter choice by equal-centre held-source NLL then equal-centre Brier then higher pooled source AUC. Existing frozen epoch/AUC-selected historical results used only for reproduction.
fixed_refit_epochs: median of source chosen seed/fold best epochs, no outer selection
patient_weight: centre-balanced BCE/ranking; ARDR equally weights centres; Global/KL use patient averages per supplied definitions
anchor: Frozen original Stage196/199 legal source models; training anchor in-sample, selection/validation anchor excludes held source patients. Optimism audited and no source-risk generalization guarantee.
pilot: All six methods and all fixed candidates, three seeds; only one prespecified source held-centre. No outer predictions in pilot. Stop if all ARDR candidates collapse (mean abs correction<=.01, or <10% of A0) and none improves source-validation NLL by .001 with aggregate AUPRC gain over anchor. Otherwise full source-CV in five outer partitions.
threshold: 95% source OOF sensitivity target, lower positive-logit .05 quantile; shared RULE, model-specific source thresholds

final_admission.controls: point NLL lower vs A1/A2/A3/A4, >=3 improved centres each, Bonferroni-adjusted NLL interval upper <0 for each to claim independent added value
